title: Sanrio Hello Kitty Teardrop Stemless Wine Glass with Dipped Bottom | Tumbler Cup
descriptionText:
Add a touch of modern elegance to your home with this Sanrio Hello Kitty Teardrop Stemless Wine Glass. The glass is made of high-quality BPA-free glass with a glossy finish and insulated material feature. It has a capacity of 1.3 pounds and comes in a pack of 1 count.

This stemless wine glass is perfect for any occasion, whether it's a romantic dinner or a fun party with friends. The Hello Kitty Pink color adds a fashionable touch to the glass, making it a great addition to your collection. The glass is not machine washable and not microwave safe, but it is reusable and made in China.
